research_scope: XRP perpetual-futures open interest, funding, liquidations, long/short account ratios, and US-listed XRP ETF holdings-derived flows
market_cutoff_notes: Provider snapshots are asynchronous and do not share a common exact cutoff. Preserve each provider timestamp; do not average or pool incompatible universes.

observations.methodology: Provider-reported all-exchange aggregate; underlying exchange/contract inclusion and quote conversion require reconciliation.
notes: Binance account ratio 69.9% long; account counts are not notional position weights.

observations.methodology: Provider-reported seven-venue aggregate: Binance, Bybit, Gate, Bitget, MEXC, Hyperliquid and OKX; 15-minute delay stated.
notes: Liquidations are explicitly incomplete because exchanges publish only part of their data.

observations.methodology: Seven-contract universe, not seven exchanges: Binance XRPUSDT and XRPUSDC; Bybit XRPUSDT and XRPPERP-USDC; Hyperliquid XRP-USDC; OKX XRP-USDT-SWAP; HTX XRP-USDT.
notes: Its listed contract universe omits Gate, Bitget and MEXC, which appear in TradRadar's aggregate.

observations.methodology: Daily change in issuer-published holdings for four funds: XRP (Bitwise), XRPZ (Franklin Templeton), XRPC (Canary Capital), TOXR (21Shares).
notes: Nov 2 holdings 1,076,815,901 XRP across the four funds.
Last five complete trading days through Nov 2: +6,178,709 XRP.

observations.methodology: Holdings-derived daily changes across six spot XRP ETFs plus the XRP sleeve of multi-asset index fund BITW; includes XRPR where part of XRP exposure is held through another ETP; GXRP flows excluded because of a documented issuer-page capture gap.
notes: Nov 2 aggregate -32,825 XRP, approximately -$42K; total holdings 1,196,567,361 XRP.
BITW changes may reflect index rebalancing; holdings changes may include fee accruals or XRP fee payments, not only creations/redemptions.
Latest settled data_as_of Nov 2; Nov 3 not yet settled at the time of the dataset generation.

observations.methodology: Secondary report of Q3 ledger-wide stablecoin supply and transfer value.
notes: Reported RLUSD $1.01B and 98.1% share; reported Q3 stablecoin transfer value $14.09B.
Do not infer XRP spot demand from stablecoin supply or transfer value; validate against issuer contracts and ledger-level data before model use.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Most of the observed perpetual OI spread is explained by venue/contract coverage differences.
supporting_evidence: Kodexius explicitly enumerates seven contracts and omits Gate, Bitget and MEXC from its current list; TradRadar includes those venues.
disconfirming_evidence: Liqwall's $1.47B aggregate remains materially below TradRadar's $2.00B despite its broader all-exchange label.
competing_hypotheses.test: Normalize native exchange contract IDs, quote currency, multiplier, mark price, timestamp and venue inclusion; compare only the common contract set.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Residual OI differences reflect provider collection, contract mapping, quote conversion or stale-data differences.
supporting_evidence: Provider timestamps differ by up to 98 minutes and aggregate totals are not defined by one shared instrument manifest.
disconfirming_evidence: All providers show positive funding near +0.0100% per 8h, indicating some qualitative convergence in funding direction.
competing_hypotheses.test: Capture raw exchange-native open-interest endpoints and metadata at synchronized UTC cutoffs; calculate USD OI from contract-native units.

competing_hypotheses.claim: ETF flow differences are largely scope/methodology differences rather than a direct contradiction.
supporting_evidence: CryptoKeyhole covers four spot funds; XRP Insights covers six spot funds plus BITW and documents indirect XRPR exposure, GXRP capture gaps and holdings changes that can include fees/index rebalancing.
disconfirming_evidence: The two aggregates still need a common-ticker reconciliation because they share several issuer holdings series.
competing_hypotheses.test: Join per-fund issuer-reported XRP holdings by ticker/date, preserve excluded/initial/reconstructed statuses, then calculate the exact four-fund common subset.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding and long-heavy account ratios indicate leveraged long crowding that could amplify downside if spot weakens.
supporting_evidence: Funding is positive across three providers; account-long shares range from 69.9% on Binance to 75.9% across five exchanges in TradRadar.
disconfirming_evidence: Reported 24h liquidations are short-dominated ($2.7M-$2.74M shorts versus about $0.73M longs), consistent with short squeeze pressure during the observed price rise; account ratios are not position notional.
competing_hypotheses.test: Track venue-level OI changes, funding, basis, taker flow, notional long/short positioning, liquidation data completeness and spot depth through synchronized time windows.

relationship_edges.scope_note: USDC issuer identity does not imply Circle operates or guarantees third-party XRP derivative contracts.
Kodexius lists Hyperliquid XRP-USDC and Binance XRPUSDC contracts, plus Bybit XRPPERP-USDC. This is an indirect USDC/XRP market-structure link, not evidence of Circle-directed XRP buying.
Holdings changes are not identical to cash inflows; product scope, indirect holdings, fee effects, index rebalancing and data gaps matter.
Fee/reserve requirements create bounded network-level XRP utility, not proportional spot demand.

data_quality_controls: Never average provider OI totals until contract universe and timestamps are normalized.
Long/short account ratios are not position-size ratios.
Liquidation feeds may be incomplete and are not directly comparable without coverage.
ETF flow is derived from holdings changes and can include non-creation/redemption effects.
Exclude provisional, reconstructed or capture-gap rows from strict primary training unless explicitly modeled as lower-quality features.
Provider aggregators share underlying exchange and issuer data; they are not independent primary sources.
next_actions: Build synchronized exchange-native OI by contract with exact instrument metadata and quote conversion.
Reconcile the four common ETF tickers across both aggregators from issuer holdings files.
Fetch issuer primary holdings and preserve source capture timestamps and revisions.
Keep all current derivatives and ETF readings as features/observations only; no directional forecast.
